quorum_ argument of setQuorum (new quorum percentage)
threshold_ argument of setThreshold (new proposal threshold percentage)
job address argument of proposeJob, encoded into the addJob calldata
targets array argument of propose listing the contracts to call
calldatas array argument of propose holding the payloads to execute
proposalId argument selecting the proposal in queue/execute/cancel/state

eta argument of the transaction helpers, the earliest allowed execution time
voter address argument of _castVote whose prior votes are counted
support boolean argument of castVote selecting for or against the proposal
delay_ argument of setDelay, the new timelock delay

normalization_plan.reason: quorum_ is consumed only by setQuorum's bounds check and the _quorumVotes write
threshold_ is consumed only by setThreshold's bounds check and the _proposalThreshold write
job is only abi.encoded into the addJob(address) calldata built by proposeJob
targets is only validated for arity and forwarded by propose into _propose
calldatas is only validated for arity and forwarded by propose into _propose
proposalId selects the stored proposal consumed by queue and the other proposal lifecycle functions
target is only passed through the internal transaction helper chain starting at _queueOrRevert
data is only used together with the other action fields to compute the queued transaction hash
eta is only used for the timelock comparison and the transaction hash in _queueTransaction
voter is only used by _castVote for the receipt lookup, getPriorVotes and the tally update
support is the boolean ballot choice forwarded from castVote into _castVote
delay_ is only validated against MINIMUM_DELAY/MAXIMUM_DELAY and written to delay
_guardian is only written into pendingGuardian by setGuardian
amount is only forwarded to the KPR token by the guardian-only vote manipulation functions
token_ is only cast into the immutable KPR interface in the constructor
callData is built solely to be passed as the payload to the low-level external call
the eta local is computed inside queue from block.timestamp plus delay and stored on the proposal
votes holds the KPR.getPriorVotes result immediately added to the for/against tally
newProposal is the in-memory struct assembled and written to proposals by _propose
txHash is the keccak256 identifier used to set or clear the queuedTransactions flag
success carries the boolean outcome of the low-level external call and gates execution
the state local in cancel caches the state(proposalId) result used by the cancellation guard
